ls .lake/packages/ && ls .lake/build 2>/dev/null | head; cat lake-manifest.json | head -40; mkdir -p /tmp/probe && cat > /tmp/probe/t1.lean <<'EOF'
import Mathlib
#check Array.swapIfInBounds
#check @Array.swap_perm
#check @Array.getElem_swap
#check @getElem!_pos
#check @getElem!_neg
#check @Array.size_swapIfInBounds
#check @List.sorted_mergeSort
#check @List.mergeSort_perm
#check @List.eq_of_perm_of_sorted
#check @List.Perm.eq_of_sorted
#check @List.pairwise_iff_getElem
#check @List.Sorted
#check @Std.Range.forIn_eq_forIn_range'
#check @List.forIn_cons
#check @Plausible.Testable.check
#print Array.swapIfInBounds
EOF
time lake env lean /tmp/probe/t1.lean

  [inst : GetElem? cont idx elem dom] [LawfulGetElem cont idx elem dom] [inst_2 : Inhabited elem] (c : cont) (i : idx),

@List.Perm.eq_of_sorted : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {le : α → α → Prop} {l₁ l₂ : List α},

@List.forIn_cons : ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m]
  (f : α → β → m (ForInStep β)) (a : α) (as : List α) (b : β),
  forIn (a :: as) b f = do
